established: Both caster and target town checks and player/monster target-type guards precede damage; invalid skill row has its own do guard.

Damage roll and event execution occur before successful-hit and knockback flags. Player/hireling uses calc4, species boss calc3, unique typeflag8 calc2, ordinary calc1; formula rank clamps to1 after damage rolling.

Positive supplied chance draws once and uses a strict modulo100 comparison. Less than one whole life sets flag2 before missile-damage execution; no physical attack-rating roll or travelling projectile is present in these functions.
services: Damage roll/event/missile receivers, target lookup, town/type/boss/unique/hireling predicates, HP and RNG are explicit services. Supplied formula outputs100/55/32/32 are opaque routing inputs, not rank goldens.
The source bodies are unchanged. Full damage/event/stat/seed/collision/knockback mode implementation, modern executable behavior and native learned skill integration are separate work.
